visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of adult male hands holds a light-colored smartphone with slim bezels vertically against a backdrop of light-toned wooden planks with vertical grain. The right index finger is adorned with a simple, matte gray ring. The screen displays the Threads application interface, showing a post with a high-resolution image of a brown Shiba Inu dog viewed from behind. (2) The person uses their thumb to tap the dog's image, which transitions into a video play mode. The phone is held steadily, and the bright, uniform indoor lighting eliminates harsh shadows on the device's surface. The person's grip is firm but relaxed as they prepare to demonstrate a software interaction. (3) The person rotates the phone 180 degrees into an upside-down orientation. The application's user interface automatically adjusts to remain upright relative to the viewer. The hands adjust their position to hold the bottom (now top) of the device, and the thumb begins scrolling through the feed, revealing more posts and text. (4) The device is turned 90 degrees to landscape and then quickly returned to portrait. This motion causes the software's orientation lock or logic to reset, fixing the interface to the physical top of the phone. The person's movements are deliberate and controlled, showing the technical behavior of the screen. (5) The phone is flipped 180 degrees again to repeat the demonstration. The Shiba Inu video is once again prominent on the screen. A white text caption with a dark drop shadow appears at the bottom center of the frame, providing additional commentary on the feature's availability on other platforms.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 嗨各位. [Subtitle]: 我突然發現Threads的一個bug了. (2) [Subtitle]: 假如你的手機有開啟自動旋轉. [Subtitle]: 那你就進Threads裡面. [Subtitle]: 隨便點開一個圖片或影片. (3) [Subtitle]: 然後，將你的手機180度倒轉過來. [Subtitle]: 你就會發現. [Subtitle]: 你可以這樣子倒著滑Threads了. (4) [Subtitle]: 而且，這樣子轉過去. [Subtitle]: 再轉回來. [Subtitle]: 都是可以通的. [Subtitle]: 那要怎麼解除這樣的狀態呢？. (5) [Subtitle]: 也很簡單. [Subtitle]: 你就是轉個90度. [Subtitle]: 它就會馬上轉過去再轉回來. [Subtitle]: 這個時候你就沒有辦法再轉回來了. [Subtitle]: 但是要怎麼回到剛才的狀態也很簡單. [Subtitle]: 就是再做一次剛剛的步驟就對了. [Subtitle]: 這樣子轉一下，上一頁. [Subtitle]: 恭喜各位. [Subtitle]: 獲得了一支可以倒著滑Threads的手機. [Variety]: 哦對了 iPhone 沒辦法做到.
